# Outpost

> Cross-platform self-hosted dev backend — Postgres / Redis / RabbitMQ /
> Manticore Search + a GitHub Actions self-hosted-runner CI/CD pipeline,
> exposed via Cloudflare Tunnel. Two layers (Docker Compose + k3s),
> plugin-driven, AI-verifiable.

Outpost gives a single developer (or a small team) the same backend
substrate every project needs — managed databases, message broker, search,
container registry, CI runner, deploy automation — running on their own
machine and exposed on their own domain. It targets macOS, Linux, and
Windows (WSL2). One `bash bootstrap.sh` brings it all up. CI is a GitHub
Actions self-hosted runner (pure outbound long-poll, no inbound webhook);
CD is a manifest-sync CronJob in-cluster. See
[ADR-0003](docs/decisions/0003-github-actions-engine-swap.md).

## How it works (concrete)

- [core/compose/](core/compose/): docker-compose.yml + Caddyfile + cloudflared
- [core/k8s/](core/k8s/): k3s manifests (namespaces, traefik config,
  `03-ci/` CI/CD engine, `06-bridges/` data-layer StatefulSets, buildkit)
- [scripts/ci/](scripts/ci/): host-run CI scripts invoked by the GitHub
  Actions workflow (build-image, run-tests, publish-npm)
- [scripts/sync/](scripts/sync/): manifest-sync.sh — the in-cluster CD
  CronJob logic
- [templates/github/outpost-build.yml](templates/github/outpost-build.yml):
  the app-repo CI workflow template
- [platform/](platform/): per-OS bootstrap hooks (macos.sh, linux.sh, wsl2.sh)
- [platform/systemd/](platform/systemd/): GitHub Actions runner +
  outpost-verify.timer systemd units
- [platform/lib/portable.sh](platform/lib/portable.sh): cross-platform shell
  helpers including `render_template` (envsubst with anti-silent-failure
  ${VAR} residue check)
- [plugins/registry/](plugins/registry/): pluggable Docker registry backend
  (built-in: self-hosted, aliyun-acr)
- [plugins/git-provider/](plugins/git-provider/): credential + `git
  ls-remote` preflight contract (built-in: gitee, github, gitlab) — no
  inbound webhook in v0.3.0
- [bootstrap.sh](bootstrap.sh): single-command installer that detects OS,
  selects plugins, generates secrets, brings up both layers + registers
  the CI runner
- [verify.sh](verify.sh): structured health check (`--json` for AI agents);
  reconciles every `OUTPOST_REPOS` entry's live HEAD against its deployed
  tag as the anti-silent-failure ultimate judge

## AI-agent tools

- [verify.sh](verify.sh) `--json`: parseable health output
- [tests/schema/verify-output.schema.json](tests/schema/verify-output.schema.json): JSON schema for verify output (locked across versions)
- [i18n/en/docs/07-ai-verification.md](i18n/en/docs/07-ai-verification.md): step-by-step verification playbook
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): full operating skill with file pointer map and common-task playbook

## Examples

- [examples/demo-app/](examples/demo-app/): manifest-only template for onboarding a new application
- [examples/hello-world/](examples/hello-world/): minimal Hello-World application repos in 6 languages (React, Vue, C#, Python, Java, Go) — used to smoke-test the CI/CD pipeline end-to-end
